title: 3 Legends That Turned Out to Be Real (Troy, Pompeii, Vinland)
description:
Experts called them stories. Then someone dug. Troy (Schliemann, 1871), Pompeii (excavated from 1748, Fiorelli's casts 1863) and the Viking site at L'Anse aux Meadows (Ingstad, 1960; dated to AD 1021 in 2021).
Proven: the cities and the Norse camp. Debated: the Trojan War, Pompeii's exact eruption day, where Vinland was.
Animated with code, narration is synthetic.
